text:
Elena: heads up - ops-alert found an object in external-builds bucket that contains a Vault-wrapped blob. Key: build-outputs/2026-03-20/ci-secret-wrap.bin (starts with 'vault:v1:').
infra-bot: Alert: s3-external-read detected for external-builds (rule: s3-external-access). Incident 1769987654 created.
Noah: paste exact s3 uri and first ~80 chars (no plaintext) please.
Elena: s3://external-builds/build-outputs/2026-03-20/ci-secret-wrap.bin
Elena: header (sanitized): `vault:v1:7e9d4a...2c`  
looks like transit ciphertext produced by our app-transit key.
Keiko: if it's transit-wrapped, anyone with transit/unwrap via our Vault API could decrypt. Check cross-account roles and any proxy endpoints.
Noah: do we have any workload identity federation to that third-party org?
Elena: yes - we gave a short-lived onboarding role last year so their CI could upload artifacts; binding still active until 2026-09.
Oncall: immediate containment: revoke the binding and rotate any SA keys used by the external CI. Commands I ran:
```
n# revoke binding (GCP example)
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding infra-onboard --member="serviceAccount:external-ci@thirdparty.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/storage.objectCreator"
# list keys
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=external-ci@thirdparty.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# delete key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=external-ci@thirdparty.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Keiko: enable Vault audit on transit and ship logs to central for at least 90d:
```
vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_transit_audit.log
# later: forward to central logging stack
```
Noah: plan: 1) forced rotate Vault transit key used by app-services 2) rewrap any artifacts we control 3) list all buckets/keys that contain 'vault:v1:' prefix and rewrap or delete if from external CI 4) tighten Vault policy so decrypt is explicit to internal identities.
Elena: I'm kicking off a scan across our s3 buckets for objects that begin with 'vault:v1:' and will upload the list to /sec/artifacts/1769987654.txt. Found 3 objects so far across two buckets.
Noah: rotation commands (example):
```
vault write -f transit/keys/app-transit-key/rotate
# rewrap example
vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext="vault:v1:7e9d4a..." key="app-transit-key"
```
Keiko: also check if any Terraform state or CI logs accidentally stored plaintext before wrapping. Scan CI artifact prefixes for raw-looking secrets.
Elena: notified third-party SOC and legal with sanitized artifact list. Legal asked for timeline and proof of containment.
Noah: audit slice: there are failed unwrap attempts (403) from the external CI SA on 2026-03-19 and one successful internal unwrap by our build-service on 2026-03-19T11:02Z (expected). No evidence external successfully unwrapped. Still proceed with rotation.
Oncall: containment executed; binding removed and external SA keys disabled. Handing to EngSec for rotation and verification.
Keiko: change Vault policy example to restrict transit/decrypt:
```
path "transit/encrypt/*" { capabilities = ["update"] }
path "transit/decrypt/*" { capabilities = ["update"] # allow only internal-service identity }
```
Elena: rewrap completed for 3 internal artifacts; external CI artifacts were deleted from external-builds after coordination with their SOC. Uploaded proof and commands to the incident ticket.
Noah: schedule a 60-minute post-rotation audit tomorrow 14:00 UTC to review logs, rewrap proofs, and RBAC changes.
Legal: will prepare notification template for partner communications and regulatory note if needed.
Keiko: great job team, leave a final comment once overnight scan finishes.
Elena: overnight scan running, will post results in the morning. Thanks everyone.
